description: Create a binder: an ordered list of lucid.page pages and external links, each with an optional note, served at https://lucid.page/b/<slug> (requires an lp_ API key). Up to 100 binders per account and 500 items per binder. Public binders with at least one visible item are indexable.

description.description: Optional plain-text description; blank lines start a new paragraph.

items.description: Optional initial items, in order. Each needs exactly one of slug or url.

note.description: Optional note shown with the item.

slug.description: A lucid.page page slug: one of your own pages, or anyone's public or unlisted page.

title.description: Optional display title for a link.

url.description: An http(s) link. Links to lucid.page pages are stored as those pages.

name: create_binder
title: Create a binder
